svg.title: Teams connector architecture
svg.desc: Short-lived entry points: the MCP server (one stdio process per agent session), the local export UI, and the auth command. MCP and UI are thin surfaces over one service layer that holds every domain decision. The service reads and writes an account-bound SQLite store of the chat catalog and calls the remote layer through ports. Teams' private services provide the chat catalog (CSA) and chat history and members (Chat Service), after an AuthZ exchange that yields a Skype token; Microsoft Graph provides channels, people, photos, shared files and sending; Search v2 provides online message discovery. Tokens come from the shared lrh-m365-auth cache.
svg.text: Teams services for chats · Graph for channels, people, files and sending · Search v2 discovery · local catalog
teams-connector mcp · one stdio process per agent session
send_message is the only write tool
teams-connector ui · started by you when needed
surfaces/web/: Starlette JSON API + static page
Choose chats and dates · export jobs · one download
Localhost only · session token · exits when idle
mcp, ui and auth are short-lived
and may run at the same time. They share
the token cache and the SQLite store.
No background sync: history is fetched
only when a call asks for it.
service/ · every domain decision; validates input once at the entry point; never sees HTTP or wire JSON
logs.py: daily file, no message content
Every list, history and search result says which chats and
date ranges were actually fetched. An empty match is never
reported as "no such message" while preparation is incomplete.
domain/models.py: the single schema for service, MCP and web · domain/errors.py: one error kind per failure, mapped by each surface
Owner checked; old stores moved aside
remote/ · the only code that knows endpoints, wire formats and ids
one HTTP client · host allowlist · bounded read retries · writes sent once
lrh-m365-auth · profiles shared by every lrh-* Microsoft 365 connector · encrypted · locked
first-party public clients · no app registration
Skype token + regional Chat Service address
Surfaces never call remote/ or store/ directly.
